subject.title: fix(net-policy): preserve repeated secret query params

question: Should this PR decouple display redaction from git install cache identity before merge, or may duplicate-secret git update drift be accepted?
rationale: The compatibility risk is concrete, but maintainers could intentionally accept the rare upgrade drift; automation should not make that upgrade tradeoff while external proof is also missing.

options.title: Decouple cache identity before merge
options.body: Keep the display redaction behavior but preserve or migrate the git managed-repo key for existing duplicate-secret specs.

options.title: Accept duplicate-secret update drift
options.body: Merge with explicit maintainer acceptance that those rare git specs may re-clone or miss the existing managed repo on update.

recommendation.title: Decouple cache identity before merge
recommendation.body: Keep the display redaction behavior but preserve or migrate the git managed-repo key for existing duplicate-secret specs.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the net-policy redaction package and is the strongest available history signal for the redaction side of the compatibility decision.
